notes: Per-band rank choices (owner ruling 3, sim-accuracy round 9). Below level 60 the site rewrites a rotation's ranked spells: by default each casts the highest rank learned that is not above the rank the band-60 rotation names, so a deliberate downrank there (Holy priest's Renew rank 3) is kept. A row here overrides that for one spec's authored spell id from from_level until the next row or level 60: the rotation casts that rank instead. A row is adopted only where the fight is mana-bound and the lower rank raises the band's published number (bare below 60) beyond the error at seeds 1 and 50001, 10000 iterations; the evidence is in design/reviews/2026-11-02-sim-audit-round9/ranks.md. Level 60 runs the curated rotation as written, so a band-60 rank belongs in data/curated/apl, not here. sim/request embeds a copy (make rank-choices-sync); TestEmbeddedRankChoicesMatchCurated holds it to this file.
